decision.summary: Only one candidate temporary offset identified in allowed context [583,660]: a multi-sample U-down/N-up perturbation centered at index 622. The U component drops sharply (~−6 MAD) over indices 621–624 and does not clearly return to pre-event baseline by index 660; the N spike is transient (single peak at 622) and E shows only minor co-variation. Without an unambiguous opposing return on U (or correlated axes), the interval is classified as uncertain. No other temporary offsets meet criteria within the allowed context.
